currentParagraphText: “I think I’ve been pretty clear on my intent from the very beginning, even if things have admittedly moved forward faster than I originally intended—something I take full responsibility for,” Artemis said in a serious tone. “I’m not interested in anything casual, but demand some level of commitment.
